goal: Define release-grade authorization gates required before live provider execution can be allowed.
risk: AOF may overclaim that an authorization model proves live provider execution safety.
loss_boundary: Do not call v10.3 complete if it implies completed provider integration, live execution, or production safety.
evidence_plan: release docs, capability delta, requirement coverage, work execution packet, Council review, runtime audits
stop_conditions: Stop if live provider execution is implied
Stop if production safety is claimed from structural evidence alone
